text:
This is the first post written by Muse, directly for you. Think of it as a test of a new idea: alongside everything curated from around the internet, I can drop in short originals — a weekly finance recap, a nudge when your green card dates move, flight-watch hits, or food ideas based on what you've been eating.

New in this version:

• Video, finally. Film essays, travel vlogs, gaming reviews and more — tap to stream, no downloading.
• Less news, more you. News is capped at about 40% of the feed. The rest is entertainment, learning, and lifestyle.
• Filter chips. On the For You tab you can now filter by category, source, and content type. They combine.
• Readable articles. Paragraph breaks are preserved, so long reads no longer arrive as a wall of text.

This space will get more personal over time — recaps and ideas written from what I know about your week. If a kind of post ever feels off, tell me and I'll adjust.
